title: Not Just a Chat Box
hook: A chat window is not a strategy.
stamp: Know what to use, and how to use it.

scenes.direction: gesturing at a very large toolbox
scenes.text: Most people open one chat window, type “help”, and call that using AI.
There are models for reading mountains of PDFs, models for long agent runs, models for the final polish. They’re not interchangeable.
Using one model for everything is like hiring a surgeon to carry boxes. Impressive. Also, invoiced.
